startup_read_status.home_latest_continuity_gearbox: TARGETED_LOOKUP_NO_UNAMBIGUOUS_EXACT_PATH; Home#73 retained only via fresh Active-8 pointer; NO_BROAD_ARCHIVE_READ

agreements: Gearbox v1 VERIFIED_PASS and Step009 Heartbeat VERIFIED_FOUNDATION remain preserved; this review changes no formal state/code and claims no C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime remain zero Experience.
Gearbox v2.1 currently separates DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND into operational_progress_delta rather than verified_experience_delta; this separation must remain authoritative.
Strict bool validation is useful type hardening but does not establish freshness, authority provenance, verifier authority or replay resistance.
verified_progress_density is currently reason-only and should remain observational until independently derived and tested against self-reinforcement.
The v2.1 contract correctly keeps speed improvement NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.

disagreements.finding: New material objection on current exact bytes: select_gear_v2 canonicalizes current_gear with strip().upper(), so a value such as ' G3 ' is accepted as G3; select_gear_v2_1 later re-reads the raw caller value with upper() but without strip(), then evaluates int(current_gear[1:]). The same input can therefore pass the inherited v2 boundary and fail inside v2.1 with ValueError. This creates cross-layer parser divergence and a denial-of-routing surface.
disagreements.required_change: Parse current control state exactly once at a canonical typed boundary and pass the canonical value/receipt through v2 and v2.1. v2.1 must not reparse raw caller bytes. Ultimately current state should be derived from canonical runtime state, not caller declaration.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events grants operational_progress to DURABLE_PROGRESS or ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND from caller-supplied event_id and event_kind without durable artifact/defect proof or immutable acceptance receipt.
disagreements.required_change: Require evidence-bound OperationalProgressAcceptanceReceipt plus lineage dedupe; receipt-less raw caller claims yield zero authoritative operational credit.

disagreements.finding: v1 can return R rollback or N standby, but v2 recovery/anchor/RED-secretary overlay can overwrite selected with G1 before v2.1 sees the inherited terminal state.
disagreements.required_change: Give trusted terminal states structural precedence across v1->v2->v2.1; R cannot be overwritten by secretary/pressure/recovery heuristics and N exits only through explicit trusted precedence.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh remains caller-declared; literal true can label stale telemetry fresh because source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, scope, policy and runtime/install identity are unbound.
disagreements.required_change: Consume a replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope with trusted source, freshness and scope metadata.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict=true only replaces secretary_level with UNKNOWN; it does not load or enforce the actual fresh authority decision, so permissive caller kwargs can still determine routing.
disagreements.required_change: Project an exact trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fail closed.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis; 1/1 can appear as 100 percent thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying a safe necessary upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; fewer shifts alone is not improvement.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is reason-only now, but because it is caller-supplied it would become self-reinforcing if connected directly to routing authority.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived from a precommitted denominator/window and tested against self-reinforcement.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only inside one aggregate invocation. Same evidence under new IDs and exact IDs across later calls/restart/rollback/poll can be re-credited; same-ID/different-binding is not durably detected.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry with exact replay NO_OP, same-evidence/new-ID lineage duplicate and same-ID/different-binding IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still depends on event kind plus booleans/stage labels; exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt are not mandatory in the executable path.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable exact evidence identity plus trusted verifier acceptance receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields instead of consuming accepted ledger receipts.
disagreements.required_change: Every nonzero verified or operational credit must come from one immutable accepted receipt; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: Weights 5/4/3 for verified classes and 1 for operational classes are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup. Commit count, wake count, heartbeat count, window age or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/randomized crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen numerator/denominator provenance, exposure/censoring/order, complete assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: Cross-layer current_gear parser divergence can selectively crash candidate cycles based on formatting rather than state, biasing routing and latency samples.
Caller-created operational events can inflate durable-progress numerator without proof of any durable artifact or defect resolution.
Terminal-state overwrite can change which cycles enter rollback/recovery populations and contaminate latency/safety comparisons.
Caller-declared secretary freshness and incomplete authority projection invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle, closure or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density can become self-reinforcing if policy-created progress is fed back into routing authority.
Transient event identity, same-evidence/new-ID replay and direct credit bypass can inflate longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics are numerator/denominator/exposure/order/coverage sensitive and require matched paired/crossover evaluation.
proposed_tests: GB21-CURRENT-GEAR-RAW-REPARSE-131: current_gear=' G3 ' must either be rejected once at a canonical typed boundary or normalize once and produce the same result through v2 and v2.1; no ValueError may occur after inherited v2 acceptance.
GB21-CURRENT-GEAR-CROSSPATH-132: whitespace/case variants and canonical G1..G6 must produce identical cross-layer semantics after one canonical parse; v2.1 may not reread raw caller bytes.
Secretary freshness forge and exact authority-decision projection tests remain required.
Shift-rate provenance, small-n, anti-thrash chatter/release and performance non-regression tests remain required.
Durable cross-run/restart/rollback replay, same-evidence/new-ID and same-ID/different-binding tests remain required.
Verified evidence without exact trusted verifier/C receipt must yield zero authoritative verified credit.

Paired speed baseline must use durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency under sealed matched workload and randomized/crossover order.

blocks: authoritative verified Experience accounting from current v2/v2.1 paths
authoritative operational-progress/speed numerator accounting from raw caller event fields
automatic authority escalation based on secretary/anti-thrash/progress heuristics
speedup or capability claims from raw credit totals, commits, wakes or uptime

release_condition: Fresh exact-current v1+v2+v2.1 executable regression evidence exists on the same candidate bytes; historical results are not promoted as fresh PASS.
current_gear/current control state is parsed once at a canonical typed/runtime-bound boundary and is not reparsed differently by v2.1.
Operational progress remains non-Experience but every authoritative operational credit is evidence-bound to a durable artifact/defect acceptance receipt with lineage dedupe.
Terminal-state precedence is structurally defined and tested: trusted R cannot be overwritten by secretary/pressure/recovery heuristics; N exits only through explicit trusted precedence rules.
Secretary freshness and authority conflict are evidence-bound to trusted replay-resistant envelopes, with fresh authority decision actually projected.
recent_shift_rate_ratio is derived from canonical history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and hysteretic release; anti-thrash passes performance non-regression.
verified_progress_density remains observational unless independently derived and proven non-self-reinforcing.
Experience/event accounting uses durable rollback-resistant identity/lineage acceptance and auditable outcomes.

Every authoritative verified Experience credit is bound to exact evidence and trusted C/independent-verifier receipt; every nonzero verified/operational delta comes from immutable accepted receipt rather than raw caller fields.
Weights 5/4/3/1 remain labelled heuristic and are not used as capability/Trust/Identity/Personality/Governance truth or promotion threshold.

Speedup is supported only by sealed matched paired/randomized-crossover evidence over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen metric provenance and verification/risk non-regression.
P_base remains read-only; heartbeat/poll/retry/reconnect/window age/uptime remain zero Experience; v1 verified baseline remains preserved.
